reports.title: Loi organique n°08/016 du 07 octobre 2008 portant composition, organisation et fonctionnement des Entités Territoriales Décentralisées — Titre IV: Des ressources financières
reports.description: DRC's organic law establishing the fiscal regime of Entités Territoriales Décentralisées (ETDs — communes, secteurs, chefferies), the tier below province. Cross-verified against two independent hostings (leganet.cd, a Congolese legal-reference portal, and FAOLEX, the FAO's national-legislation database — neither a .gouv.cd host itself). Art. 104: "Les finances d'une entité territoriale décentralisée sont distinctes de celles de la province" [An ETD's finances are distinct from the province's]. Art. 105 lists ETD resource categories: own resources, a share of nationally-sourced revenue allocated to provinces, resources of the national equalisation fund, and exceptional resources. Art. 108-109: own resources include "l'impôt personnel minimum" (minimum personal tax), perceived "au profit exclusif des communes, des secteurs ou des chefferies" [exclusively for the benefit of communes, secteurs, or chefferies]. KEY FINDING — Art. 115: "Les entités territoriales décentralisées ont droit à 40% de la part des recettes à caractère national allouées aux provinces" [ETDs are entitled to 40% of the share of nationally-sourced revenue already allocated to the provinces] — a second, cascading 40% rule, legally distinct from (even though numerically identical to) the province-level 40% retrocession already in the corpus (cd-constitution-provinces-revenue, Constitution Art. 175). Art. 116: distribution among ETDs is based on "critères de capacité de production, de la superficie et de la population" [production capacity, territorial area, and population], with the exact mechanism left to provincial edict (édit) — not independently located this round.

dependencies.basis: Article 105 of the organic law explicitly lists 'la part provenant des recettes à caractère national allouées aux provinces' among ETD resource categories, directly presupposing the Constitution's Article 175 province-level 40% retrocession mechanism as the source pool that Article 115's own commune-level 40% cascades from.

_dropped.edge: Any individual DRC commune (e.g. Gombe, Limete, Ngaliema) or secondary city (Lubumbashi, Mbuji-Mayi) -> a self-published budget/financial-statement document
_dropped.why: Commune de Limete's own official site (communedelimete.cd) confirms a 'service du budget' exists and describes its procedural function ('Élaboration du budget communal. Suivre, Contrôler et exécuter le budget'), but publishes no actual budget figures. Ville de Lubumbashi's own domains (villedelubumbashi.gouv.cd, villedelubumbashi.cd) and Kinshasa's own revenue authority (dgrk-rdc.com) were blocked at the network/proxy level (502 CONNECT denial) rather than confirmed absent -- flagged for retry with different network access before treating as a permanent NOT FOUND. No dedicated Mbuji-Mayi city site was located at all (only news coverage). This is consistent with, and extends to a second angle, a prior round's NOT FOUND for Kinshasa's own primary budget text. FOLLOW-UP 2026-08-13 (Grok, same-day): independently re-checked villedelubumbashi.gouv.cd and villedelubumbashi.cd -- both return genuine DNS NXDOMAIN from Grok's own access path too, not just this branch's proxy -- upgrading this from an unconfirmed access-method question to a reasonably confirmed absence of any live Ville de Lubumbashi web presence under either domain.

_dropped.edge: BCC (Banque Centrale du Congo) or INS's own CPI methodology -> COICOP / IMF-ILO CPI Manual
_dropped.why: bcc.cd fails TLS validation on every page checked, including a CPI-specific URL and a PDF apparently hosting an INS-authored national-accounts document ('cpt_nat_synthse.pdf') -- a genuine server-side certificate misconfiguration (missing intermediate cert), not a proxy block. ins-rdc.org (a different, older domain than the insrdc.cd checked in a prior round) is Cloudflare-gated (403) regardless of client. insrdc.cd itself explicitly self-describes as still under construction: "Le portail est en cours d'amélioration : une bibliothèque de publications... des pages thématiques (IPC...) seront disponibles prochainement" [The portal is being improved: a publications library, thematic pages (CPI...) will be available soon] -- confirms via INS's own current voice that no CPI methodology page is published yet, on a newer domain than the one checked previously. FOLLOW-UP 2026-08-13 (Grok, same-day): reports bcc.cd loads successfully from its own access path (contradicting this branch's TLS failure -- likely a difference in fetch tooling/CA trust store, not a site-availability change) and surfaces general references to 'Indice des Prix à la Consommation calculé par la BCC' in notes de conjoncture and annual reports, but could not itself locate a standalone methodology page naming COICOP, the IMF/ILO CPI Manual, or AFRISTAT -- so the underlying question remains NOT FOUND even from an access path that can reach the site, strengthening (not just leaving open) the case that this specific methodology citation genuinely isn't published, independent of the access-failure question.
